items.name: v1.1.0
items.body:
## Overview

llama.cpp v1.1.0 adds the Inkling 2 family (base, Mini and DSpark), Domyn Edge 4B, Zaya1 8B, RAON-1-mini and Hy4 flash, splits DFlash speculative decoding into separate draft methods, and deprecates the old `llama_batch` API in favour of `llama_batch_ext`. It brings a large set of TTS and audio models (Kokoro, Zonos3-Mini, tiny-voca, VoxCPM2, MiniMax-Music3, YuE2, Fish S2, Higgs v3/VibeVoice-ASR and Kyutai Hibiki), token-aware chat parsing, named tool choice, automatic per-tensor quantization targeting a bpw or size budget, a slot-scheduling refactor in `llama-server`, a redesigned Llama Chat web UI with voice messages and agent traces, and updates `ggml` to v1.1.1.

### API changes

- llama.h: deprecate the old `llama_batch` API in favour of `llama_batch_ext` and `llama_process` ([#32306](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/32306), [#32356](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/32356))
- llama.h: add `llama_dflash_variant` and `llama_model_dflash_variant()` for the four DFlash draft heads ([#32016](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/32016))
- llama.h: add `llama_model_meta_arr_n()` and `llama_model_meta_arr_str()` to read GGUF string arrays ([#32397](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/32397))
- llama.h: add `target_bpw`, `target_size`, `state_file` and abort callback to `llama_model_quantize_params` ([#15550](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/15550))
- mtmd.h: add audio types for Zonos3, YuE2, MiniMax-Music3, Fish S2, Moshi, Kokoro, tiny-voca, VoxCPM2 ([#32020](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/32020), [#32330](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/32330), [#32369](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/32369), [#32413](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/32413), [#32427](https://github.com/ggml

items.name: b12776
items.body:
<details open>

CUDA: fix ROCm CI, do not pick the tile FA kernel for DKQ 576 with a GQA ratio not divisible by 4 (#33045)

* CUDA: flash attention tile kernel for DKQ 576 with a GQA ratio of 2

The tile kernel for 576/512 only had variants for GQA ratios that are
multiples of 4, while the kernel selection accepts any ratio from 2,
so an MLA attention with a ratio of 2 aborted on GPUs that use the
tile kernel, such as RDNA. Add the 2 column configuration, copied from
the 512/512 one of each table, and dispatch even ratios to it. Odd
ratios have no tile variant: the selection now reports them as
unsupported instead of picking the tile kernel. Cover the ratios 2
and 3 in test-backend-ops.

* CUDA: pass the K/V types to the tile kernel for 576 with a GQA ratio of 2

#32901 added the K and V types as template parameters of the tile kernel,
the ratio 2 dispatch for DKQ 576 still used the old parameter list.

* CUDA: report DKQ 576 with a GQA ratio not divisible by 4 as unsupported by the tile kernel

Use the selection instead of a new tile specialization, as suggested in
review: drop the 2 column variant and only pick the tile kernel for
576/512 when the GQA ratio is a multiple of 4, the ncols2 = 4 and 16
variants it has. The ncols2 = 4 variant cannot serve a ratio of 2, a
block reads a single K/V head.

</details>

* chat : add the RAON chat template
* tests : add RAON vocab regression files for test-tokenizer-0
* llama-quant : add RAON quantization rules for attention projections
* vocab : move RAON to the standard tokenizer list and remove its dedicated tokenizer test
* convert : move MTP layer check to filter_tensors and correct comment on _KEEP_UNQUANTIZED
* convert : add orphan-scale gurad for MXFP8 scales
* model : remove redundant graph expansion, use require() for RDA head size validation, and add comment for MLA latent normalization
* llama : share KDA conv1d between Raon and Kimi K3
* convert : remove redundant MXFP8 dequantization
* model : align RAON MoE call formatting with other models
* tests : remove RAON quantization test
* model : match RAON MoE weight normalization to the HF reference
* set expert_weights_norm_eps to 1e-20, which introduced in commit 5c008e0
* tests : add Metal fusion test for Raon
